sentence: Splits a shared grocery receipt by item, where each person joins the items they had, sees what they owe the payer, and marks when they have paid back.
use_when: One person paid a grocery bill and the group needs to divide it by item
People want to pick which items they had and see their own share
The group wants to track who has paid the payer back
A shared receipt has some items for everyone and some for only a few
dont_use_when: Splitting a bill evenly with no item choices or a simple equal split
Tracking ongoing debts across many expenses over time
Sending real payments or collecting money through a payment service
